effects.prompt: Add an attack reaction card from your hand to the chain link as a defending card?

_comment:
'Defense Reaction - Destroy this: You may add an attack reaction card from your hand to the active chain link as a defending card.'

Shape copied from two adopted cards: blacktek_whisperers (dyn/) proves "Destroy this:" as an ability-level DESTROY_SELF cost (cost_types.py:43 - written for exactly this wording), and quickdodge_flexors (hnt/) proves DEFENSE_REACTION + ADD_DEFEND on equipment. The destroy is a COST, so it happens even if the optional half is declined - matching the printed colon.

ADD_DEFEND takes the canonical object-target dict (effect_types.py:2727-2740): zone HAND pools player.hand.cards (_object_zone_cards, effect_types.py:493-494), and the controller picks which card. Filter CARD_IS_TYPE normalises both sides (_norm strips non-alphanumerics), so 'Attack Reaction' matches the DB spelling types=['AttackReaction'] (verified: razor_reflex_yellow).

The MAY carries its own conditions (CARD_IN_ZONE over hand) so the prompt is only offered when an attack reaction is actually in hand. NOTE the raw-lowercase matcher there (condition_types.py:944-947 compares stored strings verbatim, no normalisation), hence the exact token 'attackreaction'; inside the target filter CARD_IS_TYPE normalises, so the spaced spelling is fine there.

Release-note behaviour ('if you cannot add ... this effect will do nothing and the card will stay in hand', e.g. under Dominate/Overpower) rests on add_defend honouring AddDefendEvent cancellation (effect_keywords.py:4039-4055, CR 8.5.32a): a canceled defend leaves the card unmoved. That assumes dominate/overpower-style prevention is registered as a replacement on AddDefendEvent - engine-side assumption, not something the JSON controls.

No activation_cost: the printed text has no {r}; the loader's text heuristic yields none and the engine treats it as 0.
